environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x runtime) behind API Gateway REST API. The API Gateway accepts multipart/form-data uploads which are stored to S3, triggering this Lambda via S3 event notification. No path validation is performed on ZIP entry names. The Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject on the upload bucket and write access to /tmp (512MB ephemeral storage). No WAF is attached to the API Gateway stage.
